title: Check whether the scope-training export has been missing its negatives
description:
Finding from the relevance sweep (PPY-7a1ca2), not fixed yet.

Evidence: 'references export-scope-training' (src/papyrus_content/references_commands.py -> reference_exports.build_reference_scope_training_export) lists Message records and reads each curation Message's metadata field to find the rejection reason code; only out_of_scope and policy_exclusion rejections become negatives. But the reviewReferenceCuration handler (amplify/functions/category-action/handler.ts) writes that metadata to a ModelAttachment (role metadata), not to Message.metadata, and the Python authoring client strips 'metadata' from Message writes (graphql_authoring.strip_unsupported_payload_fields). If Message.metadata is empty in production, every rejected reference has no reason code and the export has produced positives only. The relevance sweep reads the attachment instead (relevance_sweep._owner_metadata).

Acceptance criteria:
- Count, in production, rejected references whose curation Messages carry a reason code in Message.metadata versus only in the metadata attachment; record the numbers here.
- If negatives were missing: the export reads the reason code from the metadata attachment (sharing the sweep's helper), a spec covers a rejected out_of_scope reference whose reason lives only in the attachment, and earlier exports are noted as positives-only.
- If they were not missing: record the evidence and close.
right_now_summary: The team is checking production exports to see whether missing attachment data caused rejected examples to lack
